title: A map ready to send
description: A preview of the pages, the pictures and the reading order before exporting.

blocks.text: The recipient needs readable material without installing the original editor. The fact that a file was created does not yet mean it is easy to open.

quote.text: Exporting as a jpg or a png fails to load, like the file is corrupted. I did have success with a PDF export, though.

blocks.text: Let people check the scale, the pagination and whether the attachments survived. Offer a format for reading, for presenting or for further editing.
Test the result in an independent viewer. A large canvas calls for a separate solution for printing and for reading on a phone.
